title: Beef Gyros
shortDescription: Thin-sliced seasoned beef with tzatziki and onion in warm pita
subtitle: Thin-sliced seasoned beef with tzatziki and onion in warm pita
description: Skirt or sirloin is seasoned with gyro-style spices, seared and sliced thin, then served in warm pita with tzatziki, tomato, and red onion. The plate should read beef gyro immediately: sliced meat, white sauce, and pita — not a steak sandwich.

steps.title: Season the beef
steps.instruction: Pat beef dry. Rub with olive oil, oregano, garlic powder, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper. Let sit 15 minutes while the grill or cast iron heats.

steps.title: Sear in batches
steps.instruction: Sear over high heat 3–4 minutes per side for medium-rare to medium. Rest 8 minutes — carryover finishes cook. Slice as thin as possible against the grain.

steps.title: Warm pita and prep veg
steps.instruction: Wrap pita in foil and warm at 300°F. Dice tomato and slice onion. Optional: quick-pickle onion in vinegar 30 minutes ahead. Target oven/smoker temperature: 300°F.

steps.title: Build gyros
steps.instruction: Spread tzatziki in pita. Layer sliced beef, tomato, and onion. For photos and the line, show one open pita with meat fanned and sauce visible before wrapping the rest.

steps.title: Serve hot
steps.instruction: Wrap and foil. Hold beef and pita separately if service delays past 15 minutes — reassemble quick. Fries or simple salad are classic sides at Canadian groceries.

proTips: A touch of ground cinnamon in the rub is traditional gyro flavour — ¼ teaspoon is enough.
Do not confuse with shawarma pitas — beef gyro is oregano-cumin, not turmeric-heavy.
Sirloin is easier to slice; skirt has more flavour if you can slice thin.
tonightSpread: Pickled onion jar at the line
leftovers: Beef with eggs for breakfast wrap
whyCrewsLikeIt: Beef breaks the chicken-heavy handheld cycle. Slicing thin after a hard sear mimics vertical-spit texture without a spit in the hall. Crews build their own if you run it open on the line.
mealPrepNotes: Freeze beef 20 minutes for easier thin slicing if needed. Seasoning can be mixed ahead. Warm pita in stacks in foil. Hold sliced beef covered with a splash of broth at 140°F.
